# IONIC CONDUCTANCE expressed in CSF-cNs

## **1- SODIUM Voltage-dependent channels (NaV)**

```{r}

library(readxl)

NAV<- read_xlsx("NAV.xlsx")
#View(NAV)
names(NAV)

```

```{r}

NAV$Region ->Region
NAV$Cond ->Cond
NAV$Amp->Amp
NAV$Dens->Dens

```

### a1) SUMMARIZE data for NaV Currents

#### Current

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Amp,
          digits=0)


Summarize(Amp~Region,
          NAV,
          digits=0)

```

#### Current Density

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Dens,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Dens~Region,
          NAV,
          digits=0)

```

### b1) PLOT Current DATA for NaV

#### Current

```{r}

Bx_Ina <- ggplot(NAV, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lomb")), y=Amp, color=Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_Ina + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-2500, 500))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Bx_Ina.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Bx_Ina.pdf", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)


Pt_Ina <- ggplot(NAV, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lomb")), y=Amp, color=Region)) +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
Pt_Ina + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-2500, 500))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Pt_Ina.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Pt_Ina.pdf", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```

#### Current Density

```{r}

Bx_dIna <- ggplot(NAV, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lomb")), y=Dens, color=Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_dIna + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-350, 50))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Bx_dIna.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Bx_dIna.pdf", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)


Pt_dIna <- ggplot(NAV, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lomb")), y=Dens, color=Region)) +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
Pt_dIna + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-350, 50))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Pt_dIna.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Pt_Idna.pdf", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```

### c1) STATISTICAL analysis for NaV CURRENTS

### =\> KRUSKAL WALLIS test - NaV Current

```{r}

kruskal.test(Amp~Region, data = NAV)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Amp, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Amp ~ Region,
                    data   = NAV,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 4,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)
Sum

```

### =\> KRUSKAL WALLIS test - NaV Current Density

```{r}

kruskal.test(Dens~Region, data = NAV)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Dens, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Dens ~ Region,
                    data   = NAV,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 4,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)
Sum
```

### **a2)** SUMMARIZE data for NaV Current, TTX INHIBITION

```{r}

library(readxl)
InhNa<- read_excel("InhNa.xlsx")
#View(InhNa)
names(InhNa)


```

```{r}

InhNa$Region ->Region
InhNa$Cond ->Cond
InhNa$Dens ->Dens

```

#### Current density in Control and in TTX

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Dens~Cond,
          InhNa,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Dens~Region*Cond,
          InhNa,
          digits=0)

```

### b2) PLOT Current DATA for NaV-current in Control and TTX

```{r}

Bx_IhNa <- ggplot(InhNa, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lomb")), y=Dens, color=Cond)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_IhNa + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-350, 50))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Bx_IhNa.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

Pt_IhNa<-ggplot(InhNa, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lomb")), y=Dens, color=Cond)) +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))  + theme_minimal()
Pt_IhNa + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-350, 50))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Pt_IhNa.pdf", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```

### c2) STATISTICAL analysis for NaV-current in Control and TTX

#### =\> Linear Model -\> region \* Condition

#### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}

modelNaI = lm(Dens ~ Region*Cond,
           data = InhNa)

# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelNaI)

# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelNaI,type = "II")

```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

modelNaI = lm(Dens ~ Region*Cond,
           data = InhNa)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 

summary(modelNaI)


library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelNaI,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelNaI, ~  Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat

```


## 2- **POTASSIUM Voltage-dependent channels (KV)**

### a1) Potassium Current and Current densities

```{r}

library(readxl)

KVC<- read_xlsx("KVC.xlsx")
#View(KVC)
names(KVC)
```

```{r}

KVC$Region ->Region
KVC$Current ->Current

KVC$Amp->Amp
KVC$Dens->Dens
```

### SUMMARIZE data for KV Currents

#### Current Amplitude and Density Current Peak (E vs P) in Control

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Amp~Current,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Dens~Current,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Amp~Current*Region,
          KVC,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Dens~Current*Region,
          KVC,
          digits=0)


```

### b1) PLOT Current DATA for KV

```{r}

Bx_KA <- ggplot(KVC, aes(x=Current<- factor(Current,levels = c("Trans","Pers")), y=Amp, color=Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_KA + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(0, 15000))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Bx_KAmp.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

Pt_KA <- ggplot(KVC, aes(x=Current<- factor(Current,levels = c("Trans","Pers")), y=Amp, color=Region))  +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
Pt_KA + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(0, 15000))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Pt_KAmp.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

Bx_Kd <- ggplot(KVC, aes(x=Current<- factor(Current,levels = c("Trans","Pers")), y=Dens, color=Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_Kd + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(0, 3000))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Bx_KDens.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

Pt_Kd <- ggplot(KVC, aes(x=Current<- factor(Current,levels = c("Trans","Pers")), y=Dens, color=Region))  +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
Pt_Kd + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(0, 3000))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Pt_KDens.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```

### c1) STATISTICAL analysis for Kv Currents

#### =\> KRUSKAL WALLIS test - Kv currents AMPLITUDE E vs P

```{r}

kruskal.test(Amp~Current, data = KVC)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Amp, Current,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Amp ~ Current,
                    data   = KVC,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 4,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)
Sum

```

#### =\> KRUSKAL WALLIS test - Kv currents DENSITIES E vs P

```{r}

kruskal.test(Dens~Current, data = KVC)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Dens, Current,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Dens ~ Current,
                    data   = KVC,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 4,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)
Sum

```

#### =\> Linear Model -\> Region \* Current density (E vs P)

```{r}
modelK = lm(Dens ~ Current*Region,
           data = KVC)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelK)

```

#### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelK,type = "II")

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelK,
                      pairwise ~ Current*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare
```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

modelK = lm(Dens ~ Region*Current,
           data = KVC)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelK)


library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelK,
                      ~ Current*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelK, ~ Current*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Current")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat

```

### 3- **CALCIUM Voltage-dependent channels (CaV)**

```{r}

library(readxl)

CAV<- read_xlsx("CAV.xlsx")
#View(CAV)
names(CAV)

```

```{r}

CAV$Region->Region
CAV$Amp->Amp
CAV$Dens->Dens

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
CAV$Region <- factor(CAV$Region, levels =c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))

```

### a1) SUMMARIZE data for CaV Currents

#### ICa Current Amplitude

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Amp,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Amp~Region,
            CAV,
          digits=0)
```

#### ICa Current Density

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Dens,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Dens~Region,
            CAV,
          digits=0)
```

### b1) PLOT ICa per Region

```{r}

Bx_ICa <- ggplot(CAV, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Lomb","Tho","Cerv")), y=Dens, color=Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_ICa + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-200, 50))

ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Bx_ICa.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

Pt_ICa  <- ggplot(CAV, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Lomb","Tho","Cerv")), y=Dens, color=Region))  +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
Pt_ICa + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-200, 50))


ggsave(path = "Fig_IonCond", filename = "Pt_ICa.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```

### c1) STATISTICAL analysis for CaV CURRENTS

#### =\> KRUSKAL WALLIS test - CaV Current Density

```{r}

kruskal.test(Dens~Region, data = CAV)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Dens, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Dens~Region,
                    data   = CAV,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

```

### c2) STATISTICAL analysis for CaV-current in Control and Cadmium

#### =\> Linear Model -\> region \* Cond

#### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}

modelICa = lm(Dens ~ Region*Cond,
           data = InhCa)

# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelICa)

# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelICa,type = "II")

```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

modelICa = lm(Dens ~ Region*Cond,
           data = InhCa)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelICa)


library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelICa,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelICa, ~ Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat

```
